subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Jane,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — great to learn more about Acme's roadmap. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step: 

- Goal: move from pilot to dedicated capacity for production inference (customer-facing chat and batch reranking).
- Expected peak traffic: ~120 concurrent requests, ~350k tokens/minute (aggregate).
- Latency SLO: p95 generation latency under 300ms for short prompts; batch jobs can tolerate higher tail.
- Key attendees for the sizing call: you (product), your infra/ML engineer (to discuss traffic patterns), and our solutions engineer to run the throughput/latency modeling.

Can we schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive + walkthrough of our Dedicated offering and config options)? I can bring Camila (SE) to cover kernels/batching/kv cache and to outline quantization/instance profiles.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 18 Jun 2026, 11:00–11:45 AM
- Fri 19 Jun 2026, 2:00–2:45 PM

I've attached a short pricing primer and paste below the calendar link — if those times don't work, send a couple that do and we'll adapt. Also, if you can share a short traffic sample from your pilot (CSV) ahead of the call that would help our sizing prep.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (pricing primer)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
https://redwood.com

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. We definitely want a technical deep dive with the SE to validate throughput/latency and get a recommendation for instance sizing and batching profiles.

Attendees I plan to include:
- Jane Doe (product)
- Samir Patel (infra/ML engineer) — samir.patel@acme.com
- Procurement (I will loop them in after we confirm scope)

Both proposed slots look doable on our side; Thu 18 Jun 11:00 AM PT would be my preference. If you can send a calendar invite I'll accept.

I'm attaching a short doc with our SLA and security checklist for reference — procurement will want to see this. Also, I'll try to share a sanitized traffic sample (CSV) before the call.

Thanks,
Jane

I'll go ahead and book Thu 18 Jun 2026, 11:00–11:45 AM PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Pre-call asks (short):
- Traffic sample (CSV) with request timestamps, tokens per request, and a 24–72 hour window if possible.
- Which model(s) you'll be running in prod (Open model name / param size).
- Any hard latency/throughput constraints from SLAs.

I attached our pricing primer in the initial note; we'll also share a short test harness we use for throughput runs. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa
